correctness.rationale: Fully specified line graph on 15 labelled vertices; all 32768 masks are checked by two independent closure algorithms. Every subset through cardinality 6 and all 6435 cardinality-7 candidates are exhausted. The 120 symbol permutations produce exactly 21 complete orbits, and breadth-first search from all 2280 optimal masks counts every unordered pair once and proves connectivity/diameter. The embedded verifier was executed and printed VERIFY_OK. Finite statement only; no inference from numerical sampling.

value.rationale: The number alone is not the motivation: this is the complete equality-classification of a canonical snark line graph, naturally corresponding to initial edge-state monitoring. Its 21 inequivalent optimal seed patterns, three propagation-time levels, complete exchange graph connectivity and seven-step diameter give a reproducible benchmark and show optimal placements can be continuously reconfigured. The distinct structures and complete metric distribution are not routine deductions from a known scalar zero forcing number.
